title.narrative: Supporting the Continuity of Educational Services and Recovery of the Education Sector from the Effects of the Crisis and Displacement in Aden, Lahij and Taiz Governorates

description.narrative: Contribute to the continued improvement of educational services in Aden, Lahij and Taiz governorates, Republic of Yemen, by rehabilitating classrooms and restrooms in addition to building additional classrooms and restrooms in 12 targeted schools. The project will also furnish and equip the targeted schools and provide solar power systems to help accommodate more students, including displaced, returnee and host-community students.

Contributing to the continued improvement of educational services and easing tensions in communities affected by displacement due to limited resources in communities affected by crises and displacement in Aden, Lahij and Taiz governorates, by expanding schools' capacity to accommodate more students, including displaced, returnee and host-community students, through the rehabilitation of 12 schools.

Rehabilitation of classrooms in 12 schools and construction of some additional classrooms. Supply and installation of 8 solar power systems in 8 schools. Rehabilitation and construction of restrooms in 12 schools. Furnishing and equipping of classrooms in 12 schools.

Disbursement for "Supporting the Continuity of Educational Services and Recovery of the Education Sector from the Effects of the Crisis and Displacement in Aden, Lahij and Taiz Governorates" in Yemen, implemented by International Organization for Migration (IOM)
